findings.description: No reference guide for error codes, meanings, or troubleshooting steps. Developers deploying to production must infer behavior from code.
findings.recommendation: Create ERROR_HANDLING.md in project root with all error codes, status codes, HTTP responses, and explanations.

findings.description: No centralized registry of error codes. Frontend hardcodes error code checks with no single source of truth.
findings.recommendation: Create ERROR_CODES.json mapping codes to meanings and recommended user messages.

findings.issue: Email notifications disabled silently on missing credentials
findings.description: When EMAIL_USER/EMAIL_PASSWORD are not configured, warnings appear in console but staff assigned to schedules won't receive emails and won't know why.
findings.recommendation: Either log a startup warning visible to admins, show a dashboard banner when email is disabled, or return 503 on email endpoints with a clear message.

findings.issue: No refresh-token mechanism; all sessions terminate on token expiry
findings.description: When token expires, frontend clears it immediately and redirects to login. No refresh flow means users lose session instantly. Acceptable for demo/free-tier, but production systems should implement refresh tokens.
findings.recommendation: For production: implement refresh-token flow to extend sessions gracefully. Current design is acceptable for Render free-tier deployment.
